relations.reason: Mechanical registry of permitted facilities from structured sources.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Facility permit identity and name remain factual registry entries without any analytical purpose.

relations.reason: Mechanical registry of permit discharge features.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Outfall/feature registry entries are source-evidenced structural facts independent of compliance questions.
Parameter code catalog entries are stable descriptive facts regardless of which purpose is active.

relations.reason: Mechanical registry of DMR monitoring period end dates.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Monitoring period end dates are recorded DMR calendar facts, not purpose-relative classifications.

relations.reason: Mechanical compilation of permit limit-set bundles.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Limit-set bundle records are verbatim permit schedule structure, not answers to a purpose.

relations.reason: Mechanical compilation of permit limit rows.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Permit limit rows are authoritative source-recorded limits whose truth does not depend on which diligence question is asked.

relations.reason: Mechanical compilation of DMR measurement rows.
relations.purpose_independence_test: DMR measurement rows are reported values as recorded; they are not purpose-relative judgments.
Calendar overlap is a deterministic date relation computed from compiled periods without purpose policy.
Structural candidate pairing is a mechanical join over shared keys without selecting an applicable limit for a purpose.
FY2025 membership is a fixed temporal filter from the intention contract; the measurement facts themselves are purpose-independent even though the window is contract-scoped.

relations.reason: Deterministic derived FY2025 monitoring requirement filter.
relations.purpose_independence_test: FY2025 requirement intersection is a fixed temporal filter over compiled limit effective dates, not a Purpose B applicability answer.
Numeric-result presence is a mechanical predicate on DMR value shape, not a compliance or purpose outcome.

relations.reason: Deterministic derived expectation universe for Purpose C.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Expectation slots lacking numeric results are compiled universe facts for Purpose C, but the underlying absence/presence of numeric values is source-evidenced rather than an answer to Purpose C.

relations.reason: Semantic WORLD relation for positively evidenced operational facts; only ACCEPT adjudications are persisted as World assertions.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Positive operational or discharge-occurrence facts, once evidenced, remain true operational history independent of which analytical purpose is active.

relations.reason: Purpose A limit-selection judgment; retained in Purpose IR only.

relations.reason: Purpose A comparison-regime classification; retained in Purpose IR only.

relations.reason: Purpose A exceedance determination; retained in Purpose IR only.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Exceedance outcomes are Purpose A compliance determinations and must not be treated as purpose-independent world facts.

relations.reason: Purpose B applicability judgment; retained in Purpose IR only.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Whether monitoring was required for FY2025 is Purpose B's three-valued applicability question and depends on purpose framing.

relations.reason: Purpose C missing-evidence taxonomy; retained in Purpose IR only.

limitations: 00_intention_contract.json does not declare an explicit consumer_fields block; semantic_identity bindings are derived from row_expectations and universe_scope granularity for purposes A, B, and C.

Permit PDF prose beyond structured CSV fields is not fully enumerated in sources/; evidenced_operational_context and conditional requirement evaluation may be incomplete until permit extraction passes run.
Closed-world negatives (e.g., established absence of a limit) are not modeled as World relations per kernel constraints.
No evidenced_operational_context tuples were persisted: all 28 adjudicated obligations were UNRESOLVED and lacked positive operational evidence required for ACCEPT World assertions.
Purpose adjudications (2506 obligations across five PURPOSE relations) were not promoted into 06_world/world.sqlite per admission policy.
